source_caption:
Taylor Swift made her feature film acting debut channeling pure, unadulterated high school chaos as the hopelessly romantic Felicia. Sharing the screen with her real-life fling Taylor Lautner, their giant-teddy-bear-wielding dynamic perfectly captures the awkward, hyper-earnest energy of teenage infatuation.

Valentine’s Day (2010), directed by Garry Marshall, starring Ashton Kutcher, Taylor Swift, Taylor Lautner.** An interconnected web of Los Angeles residents navigates the messy, hilarious, and heartbreaking realities of romance over the course of one unpredictable holiday.

#ValentinesDayMovie #TaylorSwift #TaylorLautner #GarryMarshall #RomCom

source_details.title: Valentine's Day
source_details.synopsis: Valentine's Day is a 2010 American romantic comedy film directed by Garry Marshall. The screenplay and the story were written by Katherine Fugate, Abby Kohn, and Marc Silverstein. The film features an ensemble cast led by Jessica Alba, Kathy Bates, Jessica Biel, Bradley Cooper, Eric Dane, Patrick Dempsey, Héctor Elizondo, Jamie Foxx, Jennifer Garner, Topher Grace, Anne Hathaway, Ashton Kutcher, Queen Latifah, Taylor Lautner, George Lopez, Shirley MacLaine, Emma Roberts, Julia Roberts, and Taylor Swift. It tells different love stories that occur on Valentine's Day. Valentine's Day was released by Warner Bros. Pictures on February 12, 2010. The film received negative reviews, but was a box off
